description: Solo developer building AstroGuard AI , an autonomous real-time astronaut health and radiation alert system powered by NASA Human Research Program data.
summary: AstroGuard AI is a real-time space medicine dashboard that monitors astronaut vitals and spacecraft radiation using NASA Human Research Program limits, providing instant AI medical alerts during deep-space anomalies.
details: During long-duration missions to the Moon and Mars, communication delays with Earth mean astronauts cannot wait for ground control during medical emergencies. AstroGuard AI solves this by providing an onboard, autonomous health monitoring system. Built with Python and Streamlit, the dashboard tracks four critical parameters: Heart Rate, Blood Oxygen (SpO2), Cabin CO2, and Cosmic Radiation. Using physiological safety thresholds from NASA's Human Research Program (HRP) and Open Science Data Repository (OSDR), our diagnostic engine detects anomalies like hypoxia, tachycardia, or solar radiation storms in real time and displays immediate medical countermeasures.
dataRefs: NASA Human Research Program (HRP) - Physiological Baselines & Spaceflight Limits
projectRefs: Canadian Space Agency (CSA) - Monitoring Radiation for Astronauts Health
